title: Principle Graph v1
description: Cross-source relationships between a multi-source subagent's principles (Step 7 Phase C). Lives at principles/principle-graph.json. Nodes are the principles in principles.yaml (implicit); edges are typed relations between them. Single-source packages have no graph file. Relation vocabulary draws on the argument-mining stance set + the knowledge-fusion synthesis plan; extend as the knowledge-fusion research finalises it.

resolution.description: For a 'conflicts' edge: how it is reconciled (which source wins / scoped applicability). Absent/empty => unresolved, surfaced to conflict-log.md.

provenance.description: Why the edge exists: cluster_id it came from, method (seed|llm), confidence.
